name: context-manager-skill
description: Saves a handoff before context compaction, holds auto-compaction until it exists, restores it afterwards, and carries it into new sessions. Thresholds are configurable per project or globally. Windows (PowerShell).

prep_at.title: Prepare handoff at (tokens)
prep_at.description: Context size at which Claude writes a compaction handoff. A project's .claude/context-manager.json overrides this.

compact_at.title: Allow compaction at (tokens)
compact_at.description: Auto-compaction is held below this size. Pair it with the auto-compact trigger (/context-manager-skill:configure can set it).

force_at.title: Safety limit (tokens)
force_at.description: Above this size compaction always runs, handoff or not.
